reviews.comment: I would not take this professor unless you are extremely politically left. As someone who is more liberal than conversative, it was still very difficult to sit through his very biased and opinionated lectures. It does not seem like a college course, but instead a seminar of personal political opinions which he loves to argue with his students about

If you have to earn credit with an anthropology class take this prof. Class was a SUPER easy A. Daily quizzes over pre-class readings, weekly group discussion and one paper due at the end of the semester. NO EXAMS which was good. The most opinionated I've ever had. If you appeal to his leftist viewpoints you shouldn't have a problem.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures are confusing and very unclear as to what is important. Probably the most opinionated professor I have had at A&M. Have bring in weekly news articles with a paragraph written about it. Then would open the floor for discussion and debate and I think it was his favorite part of the week to argue with his students. There are better anth profs

This professor is very unorganized with lecture and makes his opinions seem like facts. He promotes discussions over extremely controversial issues in class which is admirable, however he consistently backs and supports one side of the argument, bullying his opposing students into silence. Online quizzes are easy.

This professor makes class every day a pain,He misuses statistics to back his points and mocks other view points,He teaches all from opinion but delivers it as fact and he is unforgiving of different view points. He will give you a 60 on a quiz and never give you a reason and then turn around and give you a 100 on a quiz that you did as it was due.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Class was super easy, but the professor if very narcissistic and consistently gave false information. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but there were weekly quizzes that contained some lecture content.

He is a super chill prof. He doesn't care if you come or not. There's quizzes every Monday before class sometimes he post readings on ecampus but he does make you read anthropology books for quizzes. Current news articles with a small paragraph relating to anthropology are every Wednesday. Theres no test just 2 papers. Easy class I've taken.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
